topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture themes, define the learning objectives, and establish the framework for studying cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential driver mutations and non-mutational epigenetic alterations confer competitive growth advantages during clonal selection.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and the Cancer Stem Cell Model
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties influence tumor initiation and propagation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how external stimuli and chronic inflammatory signaling cooperate with pre-existing mutations to enable malignant transformation.

topics.label: Tumor Microenvironment Dependencies, Profiling Methods, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore stromal requirements in established tumors, profiling technologies for mapping tissue heterogeneity, and a comprehensive synthesis of cancer coevolution.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks conclude the session and preview the upcoming lecture on cancer therapies.
